strings.Although many overseas brokers waive tra: Although many overseas brokers waive trading commissions, funding requires international wire transfers that incur a fixed cost. If your investment amount is small, a domestic delegated account's periodic investment (regular fixed-amount) plan may be more cost‑effective.
strings.Major Taiwanese brokers currently offer: Major Taiwanese brokers currently offer US stock regular investment plans that typically provide either a flat commission (e.g., 0.1 USD or NT$1) or promotions with no minimum fee and rates below 0.1%. For a single large lump‑sum purchase, negotiating no minimum fee and a rate below 0.15% is already very competitive.
